review.why: Routes business questions through defined metrics, compiled SQL, model discovery and local artifacts.
review.summary: Adds an analyst workflow distinct from model development: verify metrics and dimensions, then use progressively lower-level fallbacks. Custom SQL still requires grain and join checks, access controls and a query budget.
strengths: Useful fallback without live database access
Grounds questions in existing business models
cautions: Requires dbt artifacts or matching MCP tools
Compiled SQL edits can change metric meaning or duplicate rows
No live warehouse execution in this review
